title: Administration and Office Coordinator, Innovation Norway Americas
description:
Innovation Norway is the Trade Promotion Organization of Norway in international markets. In the Americas region we have offices in Brazil, Canada and USA. We work with a wide range of industry sectors including energy, maritime, health, and tech.

Our Rio de Janeiro office consists of three local industry advisors in addition to the Office Director and a special envoy on research and academic cooperation. All offices also host student interns.

We are now looking for an Administration and Office Coordinator for our Americas offices, to be located at our Rio de Janeiro Office. The purpose is to ensure compliant, efficient local operations by executing administrative processes, office administration, IT coordination and finance control support in line with corporate practice and local requirements, across five office locations in the Americas (Canada, USA, Brazil).

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate job postings and assist Department Manager in organizing interviews and screening of candidates, ensure compliance with local labor rules.
  • Assist in tasks and administration related to on- and offboarding
  • Follow up on pension/insurance/phone and basic time/leave/sick leave administration as per local regulations.
  • Assist in employee processes, e.g. coordinate check ins, mandatory courses and survey follow ups.
  • Light finance and controller support, i.e. documentation and quality control

You will be the go-to-person for administrative tasks related to everything from recruitment to IT equipment. It is therefore essential that you are used to coordinating many different tasks at the same time, and that having an overall view is natural to you. A high service-oriented approach will be fundamental.

Office Administration:

  • Day to day office operations
  • HSE: make sure required annual drills, checks, and any first aid & fire response kit are within local procedures, in coordination with local offices.
  • Responsible for IT equipment and preparing system accesses as pre onboarding
  • Serve as a professional contact point for embassy, consulate, landlord, vendors and/or partners on practical matters and protocol as needed.

You will be the one whom colleagues go to to get updated status and information about local law, policies and internal procedures. It is therefore important that you pay attention to details, are thorough and precise and always make sure that you stay up to date on necessary information.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of operational office management experience in an international setting, e.g. office administration, PA roles or alike.
  • International experience from North America, with knowledge of local labor regulations in USA, Canada and Brazil.
  • Experience with invoices, expense reports, budget control, and necessary reporting to local government.
  • Experience of engaging with management and high-level stakeholders
  • Written and oral fluency in English and Portuguese.

Education and/or coursing within relevant fields will be an advantage.

Working model : hybrid (currently 3+2); on site presence for onboarding, events and operational needs. Location is in Rio de Janeiro, and the contract is on Brazilian terms.

The role will report to Department Manager for Innovation Norway in Rio de Janeiro, Thomas Conradi Granli.

Innovation Norway is committed to diversity. We seek employees with a variety of competencies, perspectives, ages, genders, and life experiences. Diversity is important to both our working environment and the tasks we aim to accomplish. Innovation Norway may conduct background checks on relevant candidates to verify documents and information, and to assess security-related matters. Candidates selected for further consideration will receive additional information about this process. Furthermore, applicants should be prepared to provide information regarding ties to high-risk countries as part of a security assessment.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Limpeza dinâmico e proativo para liderar nossas equipes operacionais. Nesta função, você será o elo fundamental entre a estratégia da empresa e a execução impecável no cliente. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Supervisionar e orientar as equipes de limpeza e conservação em diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos cronogramas de trabalho e os padrões de qualidade GSS.
  • Realizar a gestão de insumos, controlando a utilização de materiais e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e desenvolver os colaboradores, focando em técnicas eficientes e segurança do trabalho.
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e manter o contato direto com os clientes para garantir a satisfação total com os serviços prestados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários para otimizar a performance da equipe.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha “Segurança Sem Preconceito” , reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar, escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).
  • Segurança do Trabalho: Fiscalizar o uso obrigatório de EPIs e garantir que todas as normas de segurança (NRs) sejam respeitadas no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em produtos químicos (diluição, PH, superfícies) e operação de máquinas de limpeza industrial.
  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).
  • Possuir CNH ativa (categoria B ou superior) e disponibilidade para deslocamento entre diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de Segurança Patrimonial ou Terceirização de Serviços de Grande Porte.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).
  • Residir na região ou ter fácil acesso aos principais eixos de atendimento da empresa.

Hiring: Two Faculty Positions (open rank) for Fall 2026

Position Title: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work

Appointment Type: Full-Time, Tenure-Track

Department: Social Work

Reports To: Dean, School of Social Work

The Howard University School of Social Work (HUSSW) invites applications for two open-rank faculty positions: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor. Founded in 1867, and located in Washington, DC, in our nation’s capital, Howard University is a historically Black College/University and Research 1 (R1) institution with a distinguished legacy of advancing knowledge, leadership, and service in pursuit of social justice and equity. Serving 400 students, the Howard University School of Social Work offers two MSW concentrations: Direct Practice and Community, Administration, and Policy Practice. These concentrations are delivered through two program platforms, on-campus (Flagship) and online (Starship). The School offers specializations in criminal justice, health, mental health, family and child welfare, displaced populations, and social gerontology. We also offer three dual degree programs: MSW/MPH, MSW/MDiv, and MSW/MBA. Additionally, the School offers a Ph.D. in Social Work with specialized areas of scholarly inquiry.

Grounded in the University’s enduring motto, Truth and Service, the HUSSW prepares scholars and practitioners committed to improving human well-being and addressing the structural conditions that affect marginalized communities. The School’s guiding philosophy, Black Perspective, further shapes its intellectual and practice framework through our curriculum and faculty scholarship that examine social and economic injustice, social determinants of health, behavioral health, poverty, and disparities effecting quality of life, particularly for African Americans and other historically oppressed populations. Our School has been continuously accredited during its 90-year history. We are a highly ranked graduate/professional program at the university having been ranked by the U.S. News and World Report among the country’s top-20 MSW programs.

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Teaching and Instruction

  • Teach graduate social work courses to include use of appropriate technologies
  • Use inclusive, student-centered instructional strategies
  • Participate in curriculum development and assessment
  • Mentor MSW and PhD students

Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda
  • Produce peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations
  • Pursue funding opportunities to support research and scholarship

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment
  • MSW from a CSWE-accredited program
  • Demonstrated ability or potential for effective teaching, research, and scholarship that aligns with the school’s needs, mission, vision, and guiding philosophy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online
  • At least two years post-MSW practice experience and social work licensure
  • Applicants for associate and full professor ranks must have a record of funded research

The University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching, research and service, committed to the development of distinguished, historically aware, and compassionate graduates and to the discovery of solutions to human problems in the United States and throughout the world. With an abiding interest in both domestic and international affairs, the University is committed to continuing to produce leaders for America and the global community.

To Apply

For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vitae and two samples of scholarly work. Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $80,000 - $110,000

title: Event Controller
description:
Event Controller

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich and the Senior Event Controller, the Event Controller will support in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implementation Phase
    • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands‑on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
    • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Planning & Operational Phase
    • Support in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
    • Work closely with the FIFA27 Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
    • Assist the presentation of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
    • Support the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 accounting teams and the various budget owners.
    • Assist the review of monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required.
    • Support the preparation monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
    • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • Experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi‑entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well‑developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Have a proactive hands‑on approach to problem solving – a ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI Word & PowerPoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Identify, log, and track software defects, working closely with developers and DBAs to ensure timely resolution.
  • Provide responsive support to internal and external end users, addressing technical issues and inquiries.

  • Create clear, user‑friendly documentation to guide and support end users.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.

  • Highly adaptable and quick to master new software and technologies, thriving in dynamic, fast‑paced environments.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with automated testing frameworks like Selenium
  • English – Intermediate level – capacity to keep oral conversation with native speakers.

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.
  • Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.
  • Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.
  • Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.
  • Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.
  • Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.
  • Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
  • Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.
  • Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.
  • AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.
  • Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.
  • Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus

  • Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.
  • Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).
  • Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.
  • Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.

Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances.
  • Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1.
  • Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions.
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities.
  • An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  • Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.
  • Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

Compensation Range: $150K - $450K

The Data Scientist will develop and deploy data science solutions that address real‑world geoscientific, reservoir engineering, and production analysis challenges. You'll work at the intersection of domain expertise and advanced analytics, collaborating closely with geologists, geophysicists, petrophysicists, and petroleum engineers to translate complex subsurface problems into robust, actionable models and workflows.

  • Develop and deploy data science solutions to support geoscientific, reservoir engineering, and production analysis challenges.

Descrição da vaga

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente.

Patients are instantly matched with the right psychologist through a survey, which filters for preferences and therapy style, helping ensure the best possible fit.

On the therapist side, Terapia is a fresh opportunity, we onboard new therapists and create a fair, performance‑driven system.

Launched in Poland in December and now expanding to Brazil and beyond, this role is all about owning, nurturing, and successfully launching Terapia in a new market. Your work in the first 90 days will determine whether we scale, pivot, or adjust our investment. This is a hands‑on, high‑impact opportunity to shape the future of the product.

What You’ll Do

  • Understand your users deeply: Talk to patients (including unhappy ones) and therapists to uncover blockers, pain points, and opportunities to improve the experience.
  • Drive product and operational decisions: Use Pareto/MVP thinking to prioritize what to build, test, or skip, turning messy inputs into clear actions.
  • Launch and scale the market: Onboard and manage the first cohort of therapists, setting up processes to ensure smooth operations and high‑quality patient care.
  • Design and scale GTM processes , creating repeatable playbooks, and growing operations from a handful of users or hires to hundreds.
  • Adapt and improve continuously: Use feedback from users and local teams to optimize operations, product features, and the patient‑therapist matching system.
  • Thrive in ambiguity: Navigate challenges, course‑correct when needed, and learn fast in a dynamic early‑stage environment.

Your Goals in the First 90 Days

  • Make Terapia operational and ready to scale: Establish processes, systems, and workflows—including hiring the first customer success team.
  • Build your first cohort of therapists: Recruit at least 10 therapists who are ready and available to see patients.
  • Gain deep user insights: Interview 20 patients to identify the most pressing problems worth solving.
  • Optimize patient‑therapist matching: Refine the survey and matching system to ensure patients are paired with the most relevant therapists.
  • Close the feedback loop: Gather and share insights with local Docplanner teams to improve both operations and the product.

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who thrives in early‑stage, action‑oriented environments and can turn messy challenges into clear outcomes. You will own Terapia in a new market, driving operations, onboarding therapists, and shaping the product for local users.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven ability to own outcomes end‑to‑end: in a small team or early‑stage environment, thriving where things aren’t yet defined.
  • Experience launching a product, market, or operation from zero to first real users: you’ve been there, done that, and learned fast.
  • User empathy: you regularly talk to customers, therapists, or end‑users, and make decisions based on real insights.
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and confidently owning the results.
  • Demonstrated success in designing and scaling go‑to‑market processes .
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills: you can align multiple teams, influence decisions, and keep everyone informed in fast‑moving environments.
  • Analytical mindset: you can gather data, interpret insights, and translate them into clear actions.
  • Hands‑on problem solver .
  • English and Portuguese fluent .

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1. Intro Chat: A first call with our Talent Partner Ainhoa to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2. SHL numerical assessment: A 20‑minute SHL numerical reasoning test to assess your numerical acumen, given the analytical nature of the role.

3. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience, with Michal (your potential manager).

4. Business Case: A take‑home exercise with dedicated prep time, designed to understand how you approach real‑life problems and think through regulatory scenarios. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and another team member.

5. References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

Global Benefits

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

Local Perks

Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

A Truly Global Team

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility That Works for You

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

Focus on results: we're here to make an impact.

Think like an owner: take responsibility, drive outcomes.

Keep it simple, keep it lean: smart solutions over complexity.

Be respectful and radically honest: openness builds trust.

Learn and be curious: growth is part of the job.

title: Graphic Designer (Webtonic)
description:
About Web Tonic

Web Tonic is a done-for-you digital marketing agency serving B2B and B2C businesses generating $2M-$300M in annual revenue (Or spending at least 15k per month in ads). We operate as a full-stack execution partner - not advisors - across paid media, SEO, web development, landing page production, and marketing automation. Our clients span North America, Europe, MENA, and APAC.

What This Role Looks Like

This is not a "make it pretty" role. You’re a performance-minded designer who understands that every pixel has a conversion job to do.

About 60% of your time will be spent designing landing page mockups and wireframes in Figma for service-based and eCommerce clients - taking conversion briefs, brand guidelines, and campaign strategies and turning them into high-converting page designs ready for development handoff. The other 40% is dedicated to static ad creatives for Meta Ads and Google PMax campaigns.

What makes this role different: you don't just design - you think. You understand direct response principles, conversion hierarchy, and why certain layouts outperform others. You study what's working in paid media and bring that intelligence into every design you deliver.

Key Responsibilities

Landing Page Design (Core)

  • Design landing page wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in Figma for service-based and eCommerce clients, optimized for conversion
  • Translate campaign briefs, offer structures, and audience insights into clear visual hierarchies - hero sections, benefit blocks, social proof, CTAs
  • Build responsive page designs (desktop + mobile) following direct response best practices: above-the-fold clarity, scannable layouts, friction-reducing form design
  • Create design systems and reusable component libraries in Figma to accelerate page production across client accounts
  • Deliver organized, developer-ready Figma files with proper naming conventions, auto-layout, and clear spacing/typography specs
  • Iterate on existing landing pages based on A/B test results and performance data - not just aesthetic preferences

Ad Creative Design (Static)

  • Design static ad creatives for Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Performance Max campaigns across multiple formats and placements
  • Produce scroll-stopping visuals that balance brand consistency with direct response performance - bold headlines, clear value propositions, strong CTAs
  • Create ad creative variations for A/B testing: different hooks, layouts, color treatments, and copy arrangements
  • Work from creative briefs and campaign strategies to produce assets that align with funnel stage (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU)
  • Maintain a library of ad templates and design assets for rapid iteration across client accounts
  • Understand platform-specific requirements: safe zones, text density guidelines, aspect ratios, and format specs for each placement

Design Strategy (Differentiator)

  • Proactively pitch layout concepts, creative angles, and visual approaches based on what's converting in paid media
  • Advise on landing page structure and content hierarchy based on direct response principles and conversion data
  • Analyze competitor landing pages and ad creatives - bring data-backed design recommendations to the table
  • Collaborate with the paid media team to ensure creative output is aligned with campaign objectives and audience targeting
  • Understand the difference between brand-first and performance-first design, and tailor outputs accordingly

Operations & Collaboration

  • Work closely with the paid media specialists, strategists, and account managers to align design output with campaign performance goals
  • Meet turnaround deadlines with consistent quality, volume, and communication
  • Organize and maintain a design asset library in Figma for easy retrieval and reuse across client accounts
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and cleanly - revisions are part of the workflow, not an afterthought

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience designing landing pages, wireframes, or conversion-focused web pages for agencies, SaaS, eCommerce, or service-based businesses
  • Advanced Figma proficiency: auto-layout, components, variants, design systems, responsive design, and developer handoff
  • Proven portfolio of static ad creatives for Meta Ads, Google PMax, or equivalent paid media platforms
  • Strong understanding of direct response design principles: visual hierarchy, conversion flow, CTA placement, trust signals, and friction reduction
  • Experience designing for both service-based (lead gen) and eCommerce (product/DTC) contexts
  • Solid grasp of paid media fundamentals: knowing what creative performs for TOFU vs. BOFU, how to structure ad variations for testing, and how platform placement affects design choices
  • Ability to translate written briefs into clear, compelling visual layouts without heavy creative direction
  • Strong typographic sense and layout discipline - clean grids, intentional whitespace, readable hierarchy
  • Experience with design tools beyond Figma: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva Pro for rapid asset production
  • Strong written English (required) - ability to incorporate, edit, or suggest headline and CTA copy within designs
  • Portfolio of landing page designs and/or ad creatives with a clear focus on conversion performance

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with B2B SaaS, digital agencies, or professional services brands
  • Familiarity with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Webflow, or Elementor) and their design constraints
  • Experience with AI-assisted design tools (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or equivalent) for asset generation and ideation

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Para alcançar o objetivo de impulsionar o crescimento dos empreendimentos de nossos clientes, iniciamos o nosso time como um piloto que se compromete a elevar continuamente nossa proposta de valor. O Consultor desempenha um papel fundamental em nossa estratégia de pós-venda, garantindo um atendimento personalizado e inovador por meio dos canais mais adequados para cada cliente.

Como é ser um (a) Consultor(a) Comercial Interno:

Você será responsável por atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira através de um dos nossos 4 canais de comunicação (e-mail, chat, whatsapp ou telefone) e por CRM.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes para garantir sua satisfação, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e oferecer suporte eficaz, agindo nas demandas comerciais através de vendas consultivas.
  • Apresentar-se aos novos clientes após o credenciamento pelos canais de atendimento (escritos e telefone).

  • Atuar de maneira preditiva para antecipar possíveis churns e intervir na reversão dos mesmos.
  • Contribuir de maneira engajada para projetos e iniciativas de melhoria contínua, com o objetivo de empreender na construção do time.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos acordos comerciais firmados com os clientes.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência de, no mínimo, 1 ano na área Comercial.

  • Experiência no contato com o cliente de forma ativa e B2B.

  • Habilidade de identificar, analisar e resolver problemas de maneira assertiva.

Kabal is hiring Regional Sales Managers (Middle East, US, Brazil, APAC)

Locations: Houston · Rio de Janeiro · Kuala Lumpur

Kabal’s logistics platform is trusted by leading energy companies worldwide, and we are scaling fast. We are now looking for sharp, driven sales professionals who understand the oil and gas industry and know how to build meaningful commercial momentum.

If you thrive on hunting down new opportunities, you will feel right at home here.

What you will do

  • Own (and preferably reside in) one of four regional locations: Brazil, APAC, or Houston.
  • Prospect with purpose. Engage oil and gas operators and major service companies, qualify opportunities, and build strong early-stage momentum.
  • Represent Kabal with confidence. Communicate the value we bring clearly and convincingly. Help prospects understand the impact and value Kabal unlocks.
  • Run a disciplined sales process. Maintain clean CRM data, accurate forecasting, and a healthy, active pipeline.
  • Collaborate across teams. Work closely with sales, product, and customer success to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Meet customers where they are. Travel to rig sites, bases, and offices to bring the Kabal solution to life.

What you bring

  • Five+ years of sales or commercial experience in oil and gas, energy logistics, drilling operations, or related software.
  • Experience selling SaaS or operational technology to industrial enterprises.
  • A track record of hitting or exceeding targets in high-pressure environments.
  • Strong presence with senior decision-makers across operations, logistics, drilling, supply chain, and executive leadership.
  • Fluency in English, with additional languages considered a plus depending on region.
  • Preferably experience in logistics, personnel transport, marine operations, or drilling services.
  • Preferably a degree in business, engineering, or a related field.

Above all, you are curious, persistent, and results-driven. You do not wait for opportunities. You create them.

Why join Kabal

We are more than a software company. We are a global team shaping the future of energy logistics.

  • Work with a high-performing international team that challenges and supports you.
  • Travel, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment.
  • Sell a proven, in-demand product that customers rely on every day.
  • Help drive digital transformation across offshore and onshore operations.

Work Location

We are looking for 3 separate roles based in the designated locations, with in-country residency as a preferred condition of employment:

  • United States: Houston
  • Brazil: Rio de Janeiro
  • APAC: Kuala Lumpur

About Kabal

Kabal is the leading logistics platform for the global energy industry. Since 2011, our cloud-based software has enabled energy companies to efficiently manage and move cargo, personnel, trucks, and vessels across both onshore and offshore operations. As a core driver of digital transformation, Kabal helps reduce costs and emissions while improving coordination across drilling and production.

Our customers range from supermajors and national oil companies to smaller independents, all trusting Kabal to keep their operations moving with precision and efficiency. We support customers in more than 30 countries, including ExxonMobil, Chevron, Shell, BP, TotalEnergies, Petronas, Equinor, Repsol, ENI, and ADNOC.

Kabal is backed by Insight Partners, a world-leading technology investor.

Learn more at

Ready to help move the energy industry forward?

Apply now and join a team building the future of energy logistics.

Ready to grow with us?

Here’s what we offer you by joining us!

  • Competitive USD salary – We value your skills and contributions!

  • Sick leave – Focus on your health without the stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.
  • Refundable Annual Credit – Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work‑life balance!
  • Team‑building activities – Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after‑work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.
  • Birthday day off – Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!

About the project

At Nortal, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

Role overview

As a Senior Scrum Master , you will drive Scrum ceremonies, delivery tracking, program‑level planning, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring teams remain aligned with business goals while maintaining predictable and high‑quality delivery at scale.

Day‑to‑day responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies: daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Coach teams on Agile and Scrum best practices, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Owners to ensure backlog readiness and clearly defined sprint goals.
  • Proactively identify, manage, and remove impediments and blockers impacting delivery.
  • Track sprint progress, team capacity, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
  • Monitor Agile metrics such as velocity, burndown, throughput, and sprint predictability.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on retrospective outcomes and team feedback.
  • Support cross‑team coordination for shared initiatives, releases, and production deployments.
  • Own program‑level planning activities including quarterly planning, cross‑team dependency mapping, and milestone tracking across multiple workstreams.
  • Develop and maintain program‑level artifacts: integrated roadmaps, RAID logs, program status reports, and executive dashboards.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point between delivery teams, senior stakeholders, and client‑side program offices, ensuring consistent communication cadences and escalation paths.
  • Drive governance routines including program steering committees, delivery reviews, and go/no‑go decisions for major releases.
  • Identify and manage interdependencies across squads, ensuring alignment on shared deliverables, timelines, and resource constraints.
  • Support resource and capacity planning at the program level, partnering with delivery leads and people managers to optimize team allocation.
  • Ensure effective communication and visibility of delivery status, risks, and escalations to stakeholders and clients.
  • Promote process consistency and help scale Agile practices across multiple teams and programs.

Desired qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of experience working as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Lead.
  • Proven experience leading cross‑functional Agile teams across product, engineering, QA, and design.
  • Strong knowledge of Scrum framework, Agile methodologies, and delivery best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience managing programs with multiple concurrent workstreams, including cross‑team dependency management and integrated planning.
  • Ability to operate simultaneously at the team level and at the program level.
  • Track record of producing and maintaining executive‑level reporting and program governance artifacts.
  • Experience managing risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication in complex, client‑facing environments.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar Agile management platforms.
  • Experience coordinating releases, hotfixes, and production deployments.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role.

Talent Connection process

  • Sign up : Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review : Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact : Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
  • Knowing you better : We’d love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • Notification : When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
  • Transparency : This process is direct and without intermediaries.

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI‑driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business‑critical initiatives.

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!

O cargo conecta diretamente a estratégia de dados e automação ao dia a dia da operação assistencial, sendo o elo entre análise, governança de processos e as alavancas de resultado do time em todas as verticais de saúde: PA, Especialidades, Saúde Mental e Hospital Digital.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Este é um cargo remoto.

Buscamos um(a) Fullstack Engineer para atuar no desenvolvimento de uma plataforma de Revenue AI (Konversa), com foco em construir e evoluir os módulos core do sistema, garantindo entregas rápidas, escaláveis e integradas com múltiplos serviços e canais.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Fullstack: Construir e evoluir funcionalidades tanto no backend (APIs, integrações, lógica de negócio) quanto no frontend (dashboard, fluxos operacionais e interfaces do usuário).
  • Construção de Módulos Core: Atuar diretamente em módulos como Campaign Engine, Customer Profile, Integration Hub e Channel Orchestrator.
  • Integrações: Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs externas (ERPs, WhatsApp, VOIP, pagamentos, etc.), garantindo estabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Estruturação de APIs: Criar APIs bem definidas (REST/gRPC), com foco em desacoplamento e comunicação entre serviços.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Participar da definição e evolução da estrutura de dados, garantindo consistência e performance.
  • Frontend funcional: Desenvolver interfaces simples e eficientes (dashboard do gestor, onboarding, fluxos operacionais), priorizando usabilidade e velocidade de entrega.
  • Observabilidade e Debug: Acompanhar logs, métricas e comportamento do sistema para identificar e corrigir problemas rapidamente.
  • Qualidade de Código: Escrever código limpo, testável e escalável, com boas práticas de versionamento e revisão.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com times de backend, IA, produto e operação para garantir entregas alinhadas ao negócio.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil de construção, com mentalidade de dono e foco em execução:

  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Capacidade de tocar entregas de ponta a ponta, sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Mentalidade de Produto: Entender o impacto do que está construindo no negócio, e não apenas no código.
  • Foco em Resultado: Priorizar o que gera valor real, evitando overengineering.
  • Adaptabilidade: Conforto em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com mudanças rápidas de prioridade.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de investigar, entender e resolver problemas complexos de forma estruturada.
  • Comunicação: Clareza para se comunicar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Senso de Prioridade: Saber equilibrar velocidade de entrega com qualidade.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar bem em equipe, contribuindo com ideias e ajudando na evolução do produto.
  • Capacidade de colaborar de forma eficiente com times geograficamente distribuídos, mantendo boa comunicação e alinhamento.

Atenção: Vaga extensiva para pessoas com deficiência.

Requisitos

  • Experiência Fullstack: Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento backend e frontend (preferencialmente Node.js + TypeScript + React).
  • APIs e Integrações: Experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST e integração com serviços externos.
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e uso de bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL).
  • Arquitetura de Sistemas: Entendimento de arquitetura modular, microsserviços ou sistemas distribuídos.
  • Assincronismo: Experiência com filas, eventos ou processamento assíncrono (ex: SQS, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Versionamento: Experiência com Git e fluxo de desenvolvimento colaborativo.
  • Cloud (diferencial): Experiência com AWS ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em tempo real (diferencial): WebSockets, streaming ou aplicações com baixa latência.
  • Experiência com integrações de comunicação (diferencial): WhatsApp API, VOIP, mensageria, etc.

Obs.: necessária disponibilidade para vir ao Rio de Janeiro eventualmente (ex: 1 vez a cada 15 dias ou 1 vez por mês), principalmente para alinhamentos estratégicos.

Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.

Estamos com 1 vaga de um Especialista de TI, com foco em Arquitetura Corporativas . Confira os detalhes abaixo:

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Necessário superior completo em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Arquitetura Corporativa, Governança de TI ou Transformação Digital.
  • Desejável certificações como: TOGAF, ArchiMate, ITIL, COBIT, PMP, SAFe ou Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura corporativa, soluções cloud e integração de sistemas corporativos complexos.
  • Domínio de frameworks de arquitetura (TOGAF, Zachman, ArchiMate) e metodologias de governança de TI (ITIL, COBIT).
  • Conhecimento sólido em arquiteturas de nuvem híbrida e multicloud, incluindo serviços IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
  • Experiência em desenho e implementação de arquiteturas distribuídas e orientadas a eventos (SOA, microserviços, APIs, mensageria).
  • Entendimento de modelos de dados corporativos, integração via ESB/API Gateway e gestão de dependências entre sistemas.
  • Experiência em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, incluindo IAM, redes, firewalls, criptografia e governança de acesso.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação, pipelines CI/CD, containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform).
  • Capacidade de análise de trade‑offs técnicos e financeiros, equilibrando inovação, custo e sustentabilidade.
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados, com foco em compliance, LGPD e continuidade de negócios.

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO

Responsável por definir e conduzir a arquitetura corporativa de tecnologia do IRB, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas de TI estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio, à visão de longo prazo e aos princípios de governança e segurança, cobrindo todos os domínios de negócio, aplicações, dados, infraestrutura e nuvem.

Arquitetura e Estratégia Tecnológica

  • Definir e manter o modelo de arquitetura corporativa, abrangendo os domínios de negócio, aplicações, dados, integração, infraestrutura e cloud.
  • Traduzir a estratégia corporativa em roadmaps tecnológicos e planos evolutivos de arquitetura.
  • Estabelecer princípios, padrões e políticas de tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento com segurança, governança e compliance.
  • Conduzir o planejamento de capacidade de infraestrutura e cloud, assegurando escalabilidade, performance e resiliência.
  • Apoiar o CIO e a Governança de TI na avaliação e priorização de investimentos tecnológicos, com base em valor, risco e custo.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção da Arquitetura de Referência do IRB, em conformidade com frameworks como TOGAF, ArchiMate e ITIL.
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e financeira para adoção de novas tecnologias e plataformas.

Design de Soluções e Governança Técnica

  • Desenhar e supervisionar arquiteturas de sistemas corporativos e soluções híbridas, integrando ambientes on‑premises e cloud.
  • Garantir aderência das soluções a padrões de interoperabilidade, segurança, dados e APIs corporativas.
  • Avaliar e aprovar propostas de arquitetura para projetos estratégicos, assegurando consistência com o modelo corporativo.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IaaS, PaaS e SaaS, selecionando serviços adequados (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Garantir a governança de soluções de integração corporativa (ESB, API Gateway, microserviços, mensageria e eventos).
  • Definir padrões de design, documentação e versionamento para arquiteturas técnicas e de integração.
  • Promover a aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança e desempenho em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas de arquitetura (Architecture Review Board) e validar aderência a requisitos corporativos.

Engenharia e Suporte à Entrega

  • Apoiar times de projeto e engenharia na implementação de soluções baseadas em arquitetura corporativa e cloud.
  • Realizar revisões técnicas e avaliações de performance, escalabilidade e segurança das soluções implantadas.
  • Coordenar o desenho e execução de testes de desempenho e resiliência para novas aplicações e integrações.
  • Apoiar a automação de pipelines (CI/CD) e a adoção de práticas de DevSecOps junto à Engenharia & Plataforma.
  • Atuar como consultor técnico em projetos estratégicos, orientando desenvolvedores, analistas e gestores.
  • Supervisionar a documentação e o repositório técnico de arquitetura, garantindo rastreabilidade e atualização contínua.
  • Avaliar periodicamente novas tecnologias e tendências (cloud‑native, data mesh, AI, edge computing) para aplicação no IRB(Re).

title: Senior Revenue Manager
description:
This position will report to the Commercial Director and will be the main responsible for the Revenue strategy of the assigned hotel, lead Commercial Strategy Meetings, conduct special projects as assigned, managing rooms inventory, rates and Revenue Management systems to maximize Total Revenue and Market Share, forecasting, budgeting, business planning, the preparation of month end and ad‑hoc analysis and the communication of rates, restrictions and strategies to the assigned property.

The individual holding this position will deputise the department in absence of the Commercial Director, and is responsible for team supervision and training, including but not limited to Cluster Revenue Analyst and Reservations Supervisor.

What will I be doing?

  • Defining overall Revenue strategy for the assigned hotel, including all business segments as well as other Revenue driven Departments
  • Exploring Business Opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenging existing processes/systems/products to make improvements
  • Providing Revenue Management functional expertise to property Area Brazil General Manager and Leadership teams
  • Making Decisions and Solving Problems - Analysing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems
  • Communicating Information Timely - Informing and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner
  • Completing weekly, monthly and full year forecasts as well as budgets and business plans
  • Analysing all available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals
  • Outline risks and opportunities relative to Revenue forecasts
  • Implementation of Revenue Management action plan in a timely manner
  • Generating and Delivering Accurate and Timely Results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Ensuring that restrictions, rates and strategies are modified as market conditions fluctuate
  • Preparation of the agenda and conducting Commercial strategy meetings
  • Monitoring the compliance in terms of distribution
  • Checking distribution channels for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning, exploring opportunities in partnership with Marketing
  • Adopting new Revenue Management systems and tools to drive revenue and profit opportunities
  • Deputise the department in absence of the Cluster DRM
  • Manage and lead the Revenue and Reservations Team, as well as strategically guide the assigned Department to achieve Team and organisational goals
  • Ensure Team Members have current knowledge for all relevant processes, policies and promotions, as necessary, to perform their duties
  • Recruit, manage, train and develop the Revenue and Reservations Team

What are we looking for?

  • Min 4 years’ experience in Revenue Management on managerial level, preferably with Intl. brands
  • Degree level qualification in a relevant field (Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Marketing, Hospitality)
  • Revenue Management - Domain of revenue management area, processes and strategies. Skill in using Revenue Management systems and interpreting pricing and inventory reports
  • Strategic Thinking - The ability to analyse and summarise detailed data to make inferences and recommendations.
  • Economics and Finance - Knowledge of economic principles and practices, P&L statements, operating budgets, forecasting and scheduling, and the reporting of financial data
  • Sales and Marketing - Knowledge of sales and marketing principles, marketing strategies and tactics.
  • Adaptability - Maintains performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace
  • Communication - Conveys information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods
  • Coworker Relationships - Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organisational goals and lasting relationships
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making - Identifies and understands issues, problems, and opportunities; obtains and compares information from different sources to draw conclusions, develop and evaluate alternatives and solutions, solve problems, and choose a course of action
  • Professional Demeanour - Exhibits behavioural styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; makes a good first impression and represents the company in alignment with its values
  • Building and Contributing to Teams - Actively participates as a member of a team to move the team toward the completion of goals
  • Driving for Results - Sets high standards of performance for self-and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self-and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required
  • Organisational Capability - Evaluates and adapts the structure of own assignments and suggests improvements to work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organisational unit
  • Talent Management - Provides support and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives
  • Computer and Systems Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, Power BI, Hilton Systems preferred (GRO, OnQ R&I, OPERA, Delphi)
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;

  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem‑estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Massas, Produção e Padrão Técnico

  • Preparar massas do zero, incluindo pesagem, batimento, descanso e controle de fermentação natural ou controlada.

  • Controlar validade, giro e armazenamento dos ingredientes da pizza (massas, queijos, molhos, proteínas, etc.).
  • Apoiar o controle do CMV da praça, otimizando o uso de insumos e evitando desperdícios.
  • Sinalizar a necessidade de compras com antecedência e clareza, colaborando com a liderança da cozinha.
  • Participar de inventários e controles de estoque da área, com foco em eficiência.

Integração com a Equipe

  • Trabalhar em sintonia com os demais profissionais da cozinha e o time de salão, garantindo fluxo harmônico da operação.
  • Realizar passagem de turno com clareza, sinalizando pendências, status de produção e itens em falta.
  • Participar de reuniões de cozinha, treinamentos técnicos e momentos de alinhamento com o líder de cozinha.
  • Propor melhorias de processo, rendimento e sabor, sempre com foco em padronização e performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional que se identifique com nosso propósito e tenha as seguintes qualificações:

  • Organizacionais: Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Dominar o trabalho com fermentação, montagem e cocção com disciplina e excelência, entender que uma boa pizza não é só sabor — é técnica, padrão, apresentação e agilidade.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Valorizar a limpeza, o cuidado com os insumos e o trabalho bem feito. Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e manter o bom humor mesmo nos momentos de pressão.
  • Conhecimento: Experiência com preparo de massas, abertura e finalização de pizzas. Domínio de forno, tempo e temperatura, com atenção à padronização, porcionamento e qualidade dos ingredientes.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
